Name: ValeWake
Author: sanmu2025
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Description[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Valewake[/b] is an AI NPC mod for Stardew Valley that expands conversations and allows villagers to respond to player requests.
NPCs retain their established personalities while responding to free-form text based on the current time, location, relationship status, and shared memories. Conversations can influence friendship, and eligible NPCs can help with farm work or accompany the player into the mines.
Valewake preserves each NPC’s first vanilla dialogue of the day by default. After that dialogue ends, interact with the NPC again to begin a continuous AI conversation.
All gameplay actions are validated by the mod and require player confirmation. The AI model does not directly control movement, combat, money, or world changes.
[/color]
[line]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Installation Instructions[/color][/size][/heading]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download the Valewake ZIP file from the [b]Files[/b] section.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the ZIP into your Stardew Valley
[/color]
[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Your folder structure should look like this:
[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/
└─ Mods/
  └─ Valewake/
      ├─ manifest.json
      ├─ Valewake.dll
      ├─ config.json
      ├─ Backend/
      └─ data/[/code][list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Configure an LLM provider and API key.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]You can either install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] and configure Valewake in-game, or edit:
[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Valewake/config.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8]Example DeepSeek configuration:
[/color]
[code]{
  "LlmProvider": "deepseek",
  "LlmApiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY",
  "LlmModel": "deepseek-v4-flash",
  "LlmApiBase": ""
}[/code][list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The bundled local backend starts automatically with the mod. You do not need to run a separate terminal or Python server.
To start an AI conversation:
[/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stand near a social NPC.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Right-click them normally.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Complete their first vanilla dialogue.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Right-click them again to open the Valewake text input window.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Other AI dialogue mods that replace or intercept NPC interactions may conflict with Valewake. Disable them while using this mod.
[/color]
[line]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Main Features[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Free-Form NPC Conversations
Talk to all vanilla social NPCs using your own text instead of selecting from fixed dialogue choices.
NPC responses consider:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Their original personality and background.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Current location, season, weather, date, and time.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Their relationship with the player.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Relevant shared memories.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Information the NPC can reasonably perceive or know.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Modded social NPCs can use a limited fallback profile, but vanilla NPCs currently receive the most complete support.
Persistent Player Memory
Each NPC keeps separate memories for each save file. They may remember important player preferences, previous conversations, relationship moments, and agreed plans.
Unsaved gameplay sessions are rolled back from durable memory when the player reloads the save.
Relationship-Aware Dialogue
NPC tone changes with vanilla friendship level and relationship status, including dating and marriage.
Meaningful conversations can increase or decrease vanilla friendship when the response contains sufficient evidence and confidence. Friendship changes are limited per day, and the player receives a subtle HUD notification.
Portrait Emotions
AI responses include a validated emotional state, allowing the mod to display appropriate expressions through Stardew Valley’s native NPC portraits.
Farm Assistance
Eligible NPCs can be asked through normal conversation to:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Water eligible crops.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Clear weeds from the farm.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Chop a limited number of mature, untapped wild trees.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]NPCs can travel to the farm, perform visible work, continue selected jobs while the farm is off-screen, and return to their previous schedule afterward.
Farm jobs require at least two friendship hearts by default.
Mine Companions
Eligible NPCs can accompany the player into the mines and:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Follow between locations and mine levels.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Defend the player against nearby hostile monsters.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Mine nearby rocks and ore nodes.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Prioritize requested resources such as iron ore.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Mine a player-selected target.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]During an active expedition, place the cursor over or near a breakable mine node and press
[/color]
[code]G[/code][color=#D4D4D8]to make it the priority target.
Mine expeditions require at least four friendship hearts by default.
NPC Appointments
Players can arrange a future meeting with an NPC by agreeing on a valid location and time through conversation.
Player Confirmation and Safety Rules
Before an NPC performs an action, Valewake checks:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Friendship and trust requirements.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]NPC age and eligibility.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Time of day.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Festivals and active events.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Multiplayer host authority.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Enabled actions and target allowlists.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Whether the NPC is already assigned to another task.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Accepted actions display a native Yes/No confirmation prompt before execution.
Automatic Local Backend
Valewake includes its own backend executable and starts it automatically on
[/color]
[code]127.0.0.1:8010[/code][color=#D4D4D8].
The backend handles character profiles, memories, dialogue generation, lore retrieval, relationship decisions, and action proposals. No separate server installation is required.
Supported AI Providers
Valewake includes configuration profiles for:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]DeepSeek[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]OpenAI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Anthropic Claude[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Alibaba Qwen[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Google Gemini[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]OpenRouter[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, including supported local services[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Availability, pricing, rate limits, and model names are controlled by each provider.
[/color]
[line]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requirements[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Required
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Windows 10 or Windows 11[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Internet access when using an online model[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]An API key and available credit from a supported AI provider[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Valewake does not include an API key or free model usage. Depending on your selected provider, generated conversations may incur API charges.
Optional
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu provides an easier in-game interface for selecting the provider, model, API address, and API key. Without it, all settings can still be changed in
[/color]
[code]config.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8].
Privacy
Conversation history, NPC memories, and action records are stored locally inside the Valewake Mod directory.
Player messages are sent to the configured AI provider when using an online model. Review that provider’s privacy policy before use.
Never publish your
[/color]
[code]config.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8]if it contains a real API key.
[/color]
